faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MNNIT Allahabad JRF/Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) or Project Associate-I positions at MNNIT Allahabad is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PG degree with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA. For JRF, GATE/CSIR-UGC NET/GPAT qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years, with relaxations available for SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary varies depending on the post and year of service, ranging from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the MNNIT Allahabad JRF/Project Associate-I positions?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending the completed form and required documents to the Research & Consultancy Cell, MNNIT Allahabad.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF/Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contract basis for research purposes.

faq.question: Q9. Where is MNNIT Allahabad located?
faq.answer: MNNIT Allahabad is located in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 211004.

faq.question: Q10. Who is the Principal Investigator for this project?
faq.answer: The Principal Investigator for this project is Dr. Soumyadipta Rakshit, Assistant Professor, Department of Chemistry.
